doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Celestin's Original Tuxedo Band, My Josephine, and wearing tuxedos
summary: The Tuxedo split between Ridgely and Celestin; Paul composes My Josephine, and they discuss the tuxedo dress and brass band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Black Rag and so forth. But there was a confusion came up between Ridgely and Salastair concerning some of the money. The band broke, broke up. Salastair quit the band. In fact, the band actually didn't break, but Salastair quit the band. But John Marrera and Simon Marrera came to me and said that they wanted to get Salastair and make another band, Tuxedo band. So I was young, I followed them, and so that was the beginning of the original, Salastair's original Tuxedo band. That was in 1924. Now that made, they had two Tuxedo band, they had Ridgely's Tuxedo band and Papa Salastair's original Tuxedo band. Well finally Ridgely's Tuxedo band faded out and left just Papa Salastair's Tuxedo band in the field. And we did pretty good. So I composed a number and called it My Josephine. And that number made such a hit, that was really the making of Papa Salastair's original Tuxedo band.

The most popular number I think that he ever made. Well I was going to ask, we talked to Ridgely for about an hour or so one day, and he told us some of that story about how they split up too. And how they first started by wearing tuxedos even on the brass band they had on the street. I hadn't known that.
Yeah we always wore tuxedos. You always wore tuxedos?
Collin tie, white shirt, and tuxedo. On the dance job.
Yeah that's right. Did you ever play in any of the Tuxedo brass band?
Did you ever play in the time when they really wore tuxedos on the street?
You never, no I didn't. You weren't in that band?
No, that was before my time. But I played in the later one, when Willie Paggio and they was playing with us then.
Okay don't let me interrupt you.
